subject.topic: Exact minimal route release and required CI prerequisite repair
subject.input_summary: Read-only non-author review with reused context, not blind. Accepted only four files at 95d463c17e1a39a2e5d26c4bc18c5e69f330546c against baseline05120197073144c0f46b6fb30a192733d529cc4f. Reviewed exact diffs, 28 entry receipts, F01–03 final outputs, both normal commit gates, failed and successful remote CI evidence, publication readback and actual local HEAD/dirty hashes. No tests rerun by reviewer.

findings: C1 PASS: actual old/new explicit entry outputs establish eight corrected wrong-root references among 28 invocations. The unchanged assertion-exit CI step failed for missing prerequisites before the one-file dependency repair and succeeded in final CI run37112632596.

C2 PASS: route selection, clarification, Plan and Human Gate protections remain. Orchestrator, auto and handoff prose are exact baseline bytes and excluded from this release; original broader candidates remain deferred.

C3 PASS: accepted source identity is baseline05120197073144c0f46b6fb30a192733d529cc4f to95d463c17e1a39a2e5d26c4bc18c5e69f330546c, four files only. Route postimages match the original executable evidence. Final manifest distinguishes route-only and cumulative diff hashes.

C4 PASS: both normal pre-commit full gates completed with114PASS/0FAIL/0WARN/1DELEGATED. Final remote CI37112632596 completed successfully for the accepted SHA, including all six jobs and Required Checks. The earlier1642908 CI failure is retained, not relabeled.

C5 PASS: supplied actual remote ls-remote readback equals accepted SHA; reviewer independently read both local HEADs and protected dirty-file hashes. Production main and integration HEAD equal95d463c; integration is clean and all three existing dirty logs remain byte-identical.

LIMIT: F01/F02 Codex old/new decisions were both correct in all seven synthetic cases, so no observed prose behavior gain. F03 Claude authentication failed with zero model usage and F04 was not started. These prose changes remain candidates; maintenance consistency does not replace the frozen behavior-adoption gate.

LIMIT: this PASS approves the exact minimal route plus CI dependency release only. It does not establish automatic hook dispatch, cross-harness model parity, efficiency, real migration, or overall three-module superiority.
